release_notes:
1. Variant SKU Accuracy: Accurately resolves variant SKU (e.g. BHK125-B for Steel Blue) from combination mapping and DOM without falling back to parent SKU.
2. Clean GA4 Schema: Removed item_id_gmc, item_id_meta, and compound ID options to strictly push base product ID as item_id, active combination ID as variant_id, and variant reference as sku_id.
3. Product Title Reliability: Corrected product title selector to reliably extract full product name across themes.
